question.prompt: Plan A: fixed monthly emissions of 30 kg, plus 0.1 kg for every 1 km traveled. Plan B: emissions of 0.25 kg for every 1 km traveled, with no fixed emissions. Above what monthly travel distance does Plan A produce fewer emissions? (Unit: km)

solutions.explanation: Let the distance traveled be \(x\) km. For A to produce fewer emissions, \(30+0.1x<0.25x\), so \(0.15x>30\), giving \(x>200\). Thus, A produces fewer emissions when the distance exceeds 200 km.
solutions.title: Compare the emissions expressions
